dialog.title: Connect a Solana wallet
dialog.lead: Choose the wallet that holds your bonds. Connecting only shares your public address — no transaction, no fee.
dialog.noneTitle: No Solana wallet in this browser
dialog.noneLead: A wallet is your account on Solana: bonds and coupon payments arrive there, and you sign subscriptions and votes with it.

why.own: You alone hold the keys — Qupon never sees them.
why.paid: Coupons and redemptions are paid straight to it.
why.sign: You sign subscriptions and bondholder votes.

dialog.mobileLead: Open this page inside your wallet app's browser:

watch.title: Or view a wallet by address
watch.label: Solana address
watch.hint: Read-only: see holdings, payouts and meetings. Signing needs a connected wallet.
watch.invalid: That is not a Solana address (base58, 32–44 characters).

dialog.devnetHint: Qupon runs on Solana devnet: switch your wallet to Devnet (Phantom: Settings → Developer settings → Testnet mode).

errors.rejected: The connection was cancelled in the wallet. Try again when you are ready.
errors.notReady: This wallet is not ready — unlock it or reload the page.
errors.timeout: The wallet did not answer in time. Open it and try again.
errors.generic: The wallet could not connect. Try again or pick another one.
